content.text: Digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-works|creators]] in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela face significant barriers when trying to sell ebooks and other digital products online. Conventional payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe often exclude these markets, forcing creators to navigate a maze of high fees and limited options. This guide explains how automated ebook delivery after a crypto payment ensures you retain full ownership of your intellectual property while saving costs.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-6. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery means that once a customer completes a crypto payment, the system automatically delivers the ebook without manual intervention. This is crucial for digital creators who want to scale their business without the hassle of fulfilling each order personally. By utilizing services like NOWPayments, you can accept crypto payments at a fraction of the cost of platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale. The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-digital-art-without-2|COREMERCH guide to difference]]-between-choices-selling-presets-without-stripe-10|The Real]] becomes significant; for a $97 ebook sold 100 times, you save $921 in fees. This cost-effectiveness not only increases your revenue but also empowers you to focus on creating more content.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The foundation of this automated delivery system consists of several key components working in harmony. You begin by hosting your digital products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring your store is free and accessible. For backend processing, you can use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage orders and automate delivery. When a customer pays via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges only a 0.5% fee, the payment is verified instantly. This seamless integration allows you to deliver your ebooks automatically through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring your customers receive their purchases without delay.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automated delivery system is designed specifically for digital creators in emerging markets who face restrictions from traditional payment platforms. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates, the architecture provides a sovereign solution that allows you to operate independently. By utilizing this stack, creators can take control of their sales process without relying on third-party platforms that impose hefty fees or cumbersome regulations. This model not only fosters greater financial freedom but also encourages a thriving ecosystem of digital entrepreneurship in regions often overlooked by mainstream payment processors.
Automated delivery means zero manual fulfillment after payment.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component of the automated ebook delivery system plays a crucial role in its overall functionality. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the storefront, where your digital products are hosted. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic, managing order processing and delivery automation. NOWPayments acts as the payment gateway, allowing customers to pay with cryptocurrencies without the need for an account or KYC, facilitating a smooth transactional experience. Finally, file delivery is managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring customers receive their products immediately after payment confirmation. Together, these components create a robust and efficient system that minimizes overhead and maximizes profitability.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your automated ebook delivery system, first select your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage orders. After that, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions seamlessly. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy delivery. Finally, test the entire workflow to ensure everything functions as expected before launching. By following these steps, you can have your digital store up and running in no time, offering a cost-effective alternative to traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is entirely possible through automated systems that leverage cryptocurrency payments. By using platforms like NOWPayments, digital creators can accept payments directly in crypto, automatically deliver products, and avoid high platform fees. This approach empowers creators to maintain full control over their sales.
NOWPayments' fee is just 0.5%, compared to 10% with Gumroad.

If you're looking to delve deeper into building a sovereign digital commerce stack, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to deploy your own automated ebook delivery system. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
